hint.isekai_mahou.combat_feel_finisher: The enemy is staggering! Get close and press %s for the mercy stroke.
hint.isekai_mahou.combat_feel_combo: Spell combo: casting one spell right after another slightly raises your power. Stop and it resets.
command.isekai_mahou.combat_feel.info: Mercy stroke: %s (below %s%% health) · spell combo: %s (now ×%s, +%s%%) · smart casters: %s (%s nearby)
command.isekai_mahou.combat_feel.finishe: %s is almost dead: aim at it up close and press the use key.
command.isekai_mahou.combat_feel.no_cast: No smart caster (tag isekai_mahou:smart_casters) within 16 blocks.
isekai_mahou.configuration.hitStop.toolt: The screen holds for 2 to 4 frames on heavy hits, criticals, parries and big explosions. Visual only, on your screen only. Turn it off if it bothers you.
isekai_mahou.configuration.hitStopStreng: 100 = normal (2 to 4 frames). Lower = shorter, higher = longer.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showSpellComb: The "Combo ×N" counter next to the crosshair. When off, the bonus still applies.
isekai_mahou.configuration.finisherPromp: One line just above the crosshair when you aim up close at an almost dead common enemy.
isekai_mahou.configuration.finisherEnabl: An almost dead common enemy can be finished with the use key, up close. Never bosses.
isekai_mahou.configuration.finisherHealt: A common enemy can be finished when its health drops below this. Default: 10%.
isekai_mahou.configuration.spellComboEna: Casting in quick succession builds a counter with a small spell power bonus that resets when you stop.
isekai_mahou.configuration.spellComboWin: How long the combo waits for the next spell before it resets. 80 = 4 s.
isekai_mahou.configuration.spellComboBon: Extra spell power per combo spell after the first. 2 = +2% each.
isekai_mahou.configuration.spellComboMax: Spells that count for the bonus
Past this the counter keeps rising but the bonus stops. 10 at 2% = +20% at most.
Caster monsters dodge spells, back off, heal themselves (hitting them cancels the heal) and call for help.
